title: 疑問句、附加問句與直述句

questions.q: ____ do me a favor by lending me your dictionary?
questions.zh: 請幫個忙，把字典借給我好嗎？
questions.explain: Would you do me a favor...?（幫我忙…好嗎？）

questions.q: Tom asked me, "____ to Japan before?"
questions.zh: 湯姆問我：「你以前到過日本沒有？」
questions.explain: Have you ever been to + 地方（曾經到過…地方嗎？）

questions.q: ____ the teacher satisfied with your homework?
questions.zh: 老師對你的作業感到滿意嗎？
questions.explain: sb. + be satisfied with + 物（對…感到滿意）

questions.q: ____ is your father? He is a professor, isn't he?
questions.zh: 你父親是做什麼的？他是位教授，不是嗎？
questions.explain: what 指人的職掌，who 指人的身分。

questions.q: A: What do you do? B: ____
questions.zh: 「你從事什麼行業？」「我是個醫生。」
questions.explain: “What” 問人的職業。如果用 “How do you do?” 的話，須用 “How do you do?” 回答。

questions.q: "____ do you go to see a movie?" "Twice a week."
questions.zh: 「你多久看一場電影？」「一星期兩次。」
questions.explain: How often...? 問「次數」

questions.q: "____ will the train start?" "In twenty minutes."
questions.zh: 「火車還要多久就開了？」「再過二十分鐘。」
questions.explain: How soon...? 問「是要多久就…」，回答時應用「In + 時間」。

questions.q: "____ does it take to finish the job?" "A couple of days."
questions.zh: 「完成這件工作需要多少時間？」「兩三天。」
questions.explain: How long...? 問「需要花多久的時間」，回答時用「一段時間」。

questions.q: How many letters ____?
questions.zh: 這個字有多少字母？
questions.explain: 疑問詞（How）在句首，疑問句的形式要加助動詞 does。this word has ⇒ does this word have

questions.q: Will you please tell me ____ right now?
questions.zh: 你能告訴我現在幾點嗎？
questions.explain: 名詞子句（what time it is）作 tell 的受詞，詞序（S + V）不變。

questions.q: How often ____ your teeth examined?
questions.zh: 你多久檢查牙齒一次？
questions.explain:
① How often...?（問次數）
② “How” 為疑問詞，後面的詞為 (S + V) 要改成疑問句的形式，即 have your teeth examined ⇒ do you have your teeth examined

questions.q: T: Aren't you going there by plane? G: ____
options: Yes, I am not going there by plane.
No, I am going there by plane.
No, I will take a train.
Yes, I will take a train.
questions.zh: 「你不搭飛機去那裡嗎？」「是的，我要搭火車去那裡。」
questions.explain: 否定的問句，以 “No” 回答時，漢語譯為「是」。

questions.q: Children enter school at the age of six, ____ they?
questions.zh: 小孩在六歲時上學，不是嗎？
questions.explain: 肯定句 + 否定附加問句；enter 為一般動詞，所以用 don't。

questions.q: You broke my glasses, ____ you?
questions.zh: 你打破了我的眼鏡，不是嗎？
questions.explain: 肯定句 + 否定附加問句；broke 是「過去式」，所以用 didn't。

questions.q: He's been quite helpful, ____?
questions.zh: 他已相當有幫助了，不是嗎？
questions.explain: He's been... = He has been...

questions.q: Let me write it for you, ____?
questions.zh: 讓我為你寫，好嗎？
questions.explain: Let + 受詞 + V, will you?

questions.q: Let's go for a walk after dinner, ____ we?
questions.zh: 晚飯後我們一起去散步，好嗎？
questions.explain: Let's + V..., shall we?

questions.q: Peter is very popular in school, ____?
questions.zh: 彼得在學校很受歡迎，不是嗎？
questions.explain: 原句的主詞為 Peter，附加問句應用 he。

questions.q: Please pass me the chair, ____ you?
questions.zh: 請把椅子傳過來，好嗎？
questions.explain: 祈使句的附加問句用 “will you?”。

questions.q: There is nothing wrong with your car, ____?
questions.zh: 你的車沒毛病吧，不是嗎？
questions.explain: There is 起首的句子，如為否定時要以 is there 作附加問句。

questions.q: Aren't you sorry for ____?
questions.zh: 你不為你所作的事感到抱歉嗎？
questions.explain: 名詞子句（what you have done）作 for 的受詞，詞序（S + V）不變。

questions.q: ____ came to visit me during my absence?
questions.zh: 你說我不在時誰來拜訪我？
questions.explain: 句中有 Do you say 或 Do you think 時，疑問詞 who, what, where 應置於句子最前面，形成「疑問詞 + do you think + (S) + V...?」

questions.q: ____ speaks English well in the school?
questions.zh: 你認為學校裡面誰講的英語最好？
questions.explain: 同 22 題。

questions.q: Never be ashamed to ask about ____ understand.
questions.zh: 不要羞於問你所不懂得的事。
questions.explain:
① 介系詞之後所接的子句不可用 that + S + V，應用 what + S + V。
② 名詞子句作介系詞 about 之受詞時，其正確位置為疑問詞 + S + V。

questions.q: She began to dream about ____ with the money.
questions.zh: 她開始設想如何處理這筆錢。
questions.explain:
① 同 24 題。
② 本題動詞 began 為過去式，故用 would。

questions.q: You will cooperate toward the common goal, ____?
questions.zh: 你們可以合作朝向共同的目標前進，不是嗎？
questions.explain: 肯定句 + 否定附加問句；will not ⇒ won't

questions.q: Your homework has been finished, ____?
questions.zh: 你的功課已做完了，不是嗎？
questions.explain: 直述句的主詞（your homework），附加問句要用 it。

questions.q: There were not many people present, ____?
questions.zh: 沒有很多人出席，是嗎？
questions.explain:
① There 為首的句子，附加問句的主詞仍用 there。
② 直述句的動詞是 were，所以選 (B)。

questions.q: I suppose he ought to have known that, ____?
questions.zh: 我想他早就知道了，不是嗎？
questions.explain: I suppose 是插入語，要把後面名詞子句形成附加問句。

questions.q: T: You will go to Beijing tomorrow, ____? G: Yes, I will.
questions.zh: 「明天你將去北京，不是嗎？」「是的，我將去。」
questions.explain: 參考第 26 題說明。

sections.title: （二）研究題
sections.instructions: 以下十題為直接引述改間接引述，選出最適當的答案

questions.q:
Jane said, "Are you tired?"
= Jane asked me ____.
questions.zh: 珍說：「你累了嗎？」= 珍問我是否累了。
questions.explain:
① 間接直述句寫法為「連接詞 + S + V」，其作用為名詞子句作受詞。
② 間接直述句的時態與主句之時態需一致配合。

questions.q:
The boy said, "May I go along with you?"
= The boy asked me ____.
options: if I might go with you
if he might go with you
if he might go with me
if he might go with the boy
questions.zh: 男孩說：「我可以跟你一起去嗎？」= 男孩問我說他是否能跟我一起去。
questions.explain: 人稱代名詞與主從一致：May I 改為 if he might，you 改為 me。

questions.q:
Paul said, "How old are you?"
= Paul asked ____.
questions.zh: 保羅說：「你今年多少歲數？」= 保羅問我今年多少歲數。
questions.explain: 疑問詞引導名詞子句，語序為「疑問詞 + S + V」，且時態配合主句用過去式：how old I was。

questions.q:
He said, "What are you thinking about?"
= He asked ____ thinking about.
questions.zh: 他說：「你在想些什麼？」= 他問我在想些什麼。
questions.explain: 間接引述採直述語序「疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」，you 轉為 I，are 轉為 was。

questions.q: When asked whether he had seen Bob, George answered, "____"
questions.zh: 當被問到是否見過鮑伯時，喬治回答說：「見過啊，你沒見過嗎？」
questions.explain: 原句為：When George was asked whether he had seen Bob, George answered, "..."。直接引述中，喬治以第一人稱現在完成式回答：Yes, I have. Haven't you?

questions.q:
Tom asked me, "Have you seen that movie yet?"
= Tom asked me ____ that movie.
questions.zh: 湯姆問我：「你看過那部電影嗎？」= 湯姆問我是否看過那部電影。
questions.explain: 主句動詞為 asked（過去式），間接引述之現在完成式 have seen 需退一步為過去完成式 had seen，語序為 whether + S + V。

questions.q:
"Don't put it on my hat," his wife said to him.
= His wife told him ____ put it on her hat.
questions.zh: 他太太向他說：「不要把那東西放在我的帽子上。」= 他太太叫他不要把那東西放在她的帽子上。
questions.explain: 否定祈使句改為間接引述時，動詞改為 tell sb. not to + 原形動詞。

questions.q:
"Are you ready?" Frank asked me.
= Frank asked me if ____.
questions.zh: 法蘭克問我：「你準備好了嗎？」= 法蘭克問我是否準備好了。
questions.explain: 間接引述語序為 if + S + V，且時態呼應 asked 改為過去式 was。

questions.q:
Mary asked Henry, "Did you see my purse?"
= Mary asked Henry ____.
options: that if he had seen her purse
that whether he had seen her purse
if he had seen her purse
if he has seen her purse
questions.zh: 瑪麗問亨利：「你有沒有看到我的皮包？」= 瑪麗問亨利是否看到過她的皮包。
questions.explain: 引述疑問句不可重複加 that；直接引述之過去簡單式 did you see 在間接引述中應變為過去完成式 had seen。

questions.q: "Don't touch the machine," I said to him. =
options: I said to him not to touch the machine.
I told him not to touch the machine.
I said to him don't touch the machine.
I told him didn't touch the machine.
questions.zh: 我向他說：「不要碰那機器。」= 我叫他不要碰那機器。
questions.explain: said to him 在祈使句間接引述中應改為 told him，否定祈使句接 not to + 原形動詞。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 依中文提示完成下列英文句子

questions.q:
我想約翰已經走了，是嗎？
I think John ____, ____ he?
questions.zh: 我想約翰已經走了，是嗎？
questions.explain: 主句是現在完成式時，附加問句應用 have / has / had。

questions.q:
你今晚不回來了，是嗎？
You are not ____ back tonight, ____ you?
questions.zh: 你今晚不回來了，是嗎？
questions.explain: 主句是 Be V 時，附加問句應用 Be V。

questions.q:
你昨天怎麼沒有來看我？
____ you didn't come to see me yesterday?
questions.zh: 你昨天怎麼沒有來看我？
questions.explain: 主句亦可用 Why didn't you come to see me yesterday?

questions.q:
新鮮空氣對我們多重要啊！
____ fresh air is to us.
questions.zh: 新鮮空氣對我們多重要啊！
questions.explain:
感嘆句有下列重要句型，請記熟。
① How + 形 / 副 + S + V!
例：How beautiful the rising sun is!（日出多漂亮呀！）
② How + 形 + a(n) + 名詞 + S + V!
例：How honest a boy he is!（他是多麼誠實的小孩呀！）
③ What + a(n) + 形 + 名詞 + S + V!
例：What a difficult job it is!（那是多麼困難的工作呀！）
④ What + 複數名詞 / 不可數名詞 + S + V!
例：What good news it is!（那是多麼好的消息呀！）

questions.q:
在公共場所言詞要更加小心。
____ more careful in your ____ in public places.
questions.zh: 在公共場所言詞要更加小心。
questions.explain:
祈使句（表示命令、邀請、祈求、忠告…等），常用者有：
① 肯定祈使句：原形動詞 + ...
例：Pay more attention to your study.（多加注意功課。）
例：Be patient with others.（對別人要容忍。）
② 否定祈使句：Don't / Never + 原形動詞 + ...
例：Don't do any harm to wildlife.（不要傷害野生動物。）
注：Never do wrong for the sake of money.（不要為了金錢做壞事。）

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列對話翻譯成英文

questions.q: Mary: 你介意我把窗戶打開嗎？
answer: Would you mind my opening the window?
Would you mind if I open the window?
questions.zh: Mary: 你介意我把窗戶打開嗎？
questions.explain: = Would you mind if I open the window?

questions.q: Jack: 當然不會，天氣很熱，不是嗎？
answer: Of course not. It is hot, isn't it?
Certainly not. It is hot, isn't it?
questions.zh: Jack: 當然不會，天氣很熱，不是嗎？
questions.explain: = Certainly not. It is hot, isn't it?

questions.q: Mary: 是的。能不能幫我倒杯冰水？
questions.answer: Yes. Could you bring me a glass of ice water?
questions.zh: Mary: 是的。能不能幫我倒杯冰水？

questions.q: Jack: 好的。你平常喝茶還是喝咖啡？
questions.answer: Sure. Do you usually have tea or coffee?
questions.zh: Jack: 好的。你平常喝茶還是喝咖啡？

questions.q: Mary: 我都喝，但我比較喜歡吃冰淇淋。
questions.answer: Either will do, but I prefer eating ice-cream.
questions.zh: Mary: 我都喝，但我比較喜歡吃冰淇淋。

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions: 閱讀下列對話，選出最適當的答案填入各題空格中
sections.passage:
John: Hi, Jane. How are you today?
Jane: As a matter of fact, __1__.
John: Oh, I'm sorry. What seems to be the trouble?
Jane: I've got a sore throat and I think __2__.
John: That sounds like the flu. You'd better go and see the doctor.
Jane: __3__. And I can't afford to miss any work.
John: You can afford to miss two or three days better than ten or twenty.
Jane: __4__. I just don't like to stay in the house.
John: It's better to be on the safe side. Come on, I'll walk over to his office with you.
Jane: Well, all right, I guess __5__.
vocabulary_notes: 1. As a matter of fact: 事實上；實際上
4. can't afford to: 無法；不能
5. to be on the safe side: 安全一點；保險一點

questions.q: Jane: As a matter of fact, ____.
questions.zh: 事實上，我感到不舒服。
questions.explain:
① I'm not feeling so well.（我感到不舒服。）
② I've got over my flu.（我的感冒好了。）

questions.q: Jane: I've got a sore throat and I think ____.
questions.zh: 我喉嚨痛，而且我想我發燒了。
questions.explain: I'm running a fever.（我發燒。）

questions.q: Jane: ____. And I can't afford to miss any work.
options: Well, I don't mind at all
He'll probably put me to bed
questions.zh: 他可能會叫我臥床休息。而且我不能缺工。
questions.explain:
① make an appointment（約定時間），此處指去看醫生。
② I don't mind at all.（我一點都不在乎。）
③ put (人) to bed（吩咐人躺在床上）

questions.q: Jane: ____. I just don't like to stay in the house.
questions.zh: 你當然是對的。我只是不喜歡待在家裡。
questions.explain:
① Mind your own business.（你少管閒事。）
② Maybe = Perhaps（也許；或許）

questions.q: Jane: Well, all right, I guess ____.
options: I have to go home now
questions.zh: 好吧，我想我不該再拖延了。
questions.explain:
① leave it alone（不去理它；不管它）
② I shouldn't put it off.（我不該再拖下去。）
③ I'll be proud of you.（我將以你為榮。）
